title: README example calls nonexistent find_by_id() on ParsedPart
description: mime-tree/README.md line 24: 'msg.part_index.find_by_id(id).unwrap()' — ParsedPart has no find_by_id() method. Any user copying this example will get a compile error. The method needs to be added to ParsedPart, or the README example rewritten to traverse children manually.
